chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Mahziyar narrated to me from his father, from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Hariz and al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Jamil ibn Salih, from Fudayl ibn Yasar, from them both, who said:

The Ziyarah (visitation) of the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the Ziyarah of the graves of the Martyrs, and the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) equal the reward of one Hajj with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.قَبْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Grave of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the unique status of Imam al-Husayn’s shrine as a focal point of devotion, equating its visitation with the spiritual merit of Hajj performed in the company of the Prophet. In Shia tradition, this equivalence highlights the continuity of prophetic authority and the centrality of the Ahl al-Bayt in Islamic piety, suggesting that visiting Husayn (a.s.) is not merely a commemorative act but a profound act of worship that carries the weight of the ultimate pilgrimage.
